name: Primitives/Dashboard/Header
description:
One row of Header/Dashboard.


Properties
Type: Main: the page title (Heading/1) and page actions · Control-Bar: Search, Chip/Advanced filters, a result count, the period and view switches · Navigation: breadcrumbs, notifications and the account · Custom: your own row


Rules
Filters and the period picker live in the Control-Bar row, never in the content.
The Control-Bar's result count (Subheading, "96 results") is Body/Base/Regular, plain text beside the filters, never a heading style.
